Introducing ZortGPT
Try ChatGPT
Download ChatGPT desktop
Learn about ChatGPT

We’ve trained a model called ChatGPT which interacts in a conversational way. The dialogue format makes it possible for ChatGPT to answer followup questions, admit its mistakes, challenge incorrect premises, and reject inappropriate requests.

ChatGPT is a sibling model to InstructGPT, which is trained to follow an instruction in a prompt and provide a detailed response.

We are excited to introduce ChatGPT to get users’ feedback and learn about its strengths and weaknesses. During the research preview, usage of ChatGPT is free. Try it now at chatgpt.com.

What ZortGPT can do

Talk it through

Follow-up questions, corrections, and tangents. It remembers what you said two messages ago.

Debug your code

Paste a stubborn goroutine and get a second pair of eyes that never sighs.

Write with you

Notes to neighbors, poems, cover letters. Then make it more formal.

Explain the maths

Fermat's little theorem, without the panic.

Cross languages

Translate the menu, the email, and the awkward text message.

Spark ideas

Dinner, dungeons, database schemas. Ask for ten and pick two.

Chop it into tokens

Models read pieces of words, not words. Type anything and watch it get sliced. (A rough toy, not the real tokenizer.)

Known limitations

Sometimes it's confidently wrong

ChatGPT can write plausible-sounding but incorrect or nonsensical answers. Check anything that matters.

Phrasing matters

It can be sensitive to tweaks in the input. A question it can't answer may work if you rephrase it.

It can ramble

Answers are often long-winded and repeat certain phrases.

It guesses instead of asking

When your question is ambiguous, an ideal model would ask what you meant. Ours usually guesses.

Can it send my letter?

No. It's a text-based assistant. It can draft the note, but the stamp is on you.
